name: CMC invivo dMRI (NORDIC)
summary: Preprocesses in-vivo diffusion MRI (macaque 10.5T by default, or human) with the CMC pipeline: NORDIC or MPPCA denoising, Gibbs and N4 correction, TOPUP/EDDY, DTI fitting, standard-space registration and optional BedpostX + XTRACT tractography, with a QA report.
description: Wraps the SPMIC-UoN CMC_invivo_dMRI_pipeline (Warrington et al.) with a Python NORDIC implementation. AP and PA runs (one or more each) are denoised with NORDIC when matching phase images are given, otherwise with MRtrix3 dwidenoise (MPPCA), then corrected with TOPUP/EDDY (GPU by default), fitted with DTI on the lower shell, registered to standard space (MMORF or FNIRT; NMT template in nhp mode) and optionally run through BedpostX and XTRACT. Requires both phase-encoding directions and the total readout time; expect long run times.

inputs.description: AP (or LR) phase-encoding direction diffusion MRI.
PA (or RL) phase-encoding direction diffusion MRI.
AP phase images for NORDIC denoising. Must match ap_dwi count. Requires pa_phase.
PA phase images for NORDIC denoising. Must match pa_dwi count. Requires ap_phase.
T1w structural image for standard-space registration (optional).

outputs.description: DTI tensor-derived scalar maps (FA, MD, AD, RD) from the lower-shell tensor fit.
Multi-page QA report (EDDY QC, masks, tensor maps, registration, XTRACT summary).
Full preprocessing bundle: TOPUP/EDDY outputs, final 4D data, standard-space warps.
BedpostX + XTRACT outputs. Empty if run_tractography was disabled.

parameters.description: Total EPI readout time in seconds (FSL convention).
b-value threshold separating the lower shell used for tensor fitting.
Pipeline mode: 'nhp' for non-human primate, 'human' for human.
b-value ceiling for volumes treated as b0.
Combine only AP/PA runs that are matched pairs.
Enable denoising. NORDIC runs automatically when phase inputs are provided; MPPCA is used otherwise. Set false to skip denoising entirely.
Apply Gibbs ringing correction after denoising.
Run BedpostX + XTRACT tractography after preprocessing.
Extra arguments passed verbatim to EDDY (optional).

failure_modes.message: Both ap_dwi and pa_dwi need at least one run.
failure_modes.fix: Provide at least one AP and one PA DWI run.
Provide matching numbers of images, bvecs and bvals for each direction.
